description: This file contains authentication service functions for user signup, login, token issuance, and token refresh in an asynchronous Python backend, using MongoDB and JWT tokens.

methods.name: str signup(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, email: str, password: str, name: str, role: str = "student")
methods.description: Creates a new user in the database after checking for existing email, returns the user id.

methods.name: Optional[dict] authenticate(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns user information if valid.

methods.name: dict issue_tokens(user_id: str)
methods.description: Generates new access and refresh tokens for a specified user id.

methods.name: dict refresh_tokens(refresh_token: str)
methods.description: Validates a refresh token and issues new tokens if valid.
